title: SemanticAdv: Generating Adversarial Examples via Attribute-conditional Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:1906.07927v4 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved great success in various applications due to their strong expressive power. However, recent studies have shown that DNNs are vulnerable to adversarial examples which are manipulated instances targeting to mislead DNNs to make incorrect predictions. Currently, most such adversarial examples try to guarantee "subtle perturbation" by limiting the $L_p$ norm of the perturbation. In this paper, we aim to explore the impact of semantic manipulation on DNNs predictions by manipulating the semantic attributes of images and generate "unrestricted adversarial examples".   In particular, we propose an algorithm \emph{SemanticAdv} which leverages disentangled semantic factors to generate adversarial perturbation by altering controlled semantic attributes to fool the learner towards various "adversarial" targets. translated_title: SemanticAdv：通过属性条件图像编辑生成对抗样本
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNNs）凭借其强大的表达能力在各种应用中取得了巨大成功。然而，近期研究表明，深度神经网络容易受到对抗样本的攻击，这类对抗样本是经过操纵的实例，旨在误导深度神经网络做出错误的预测。目前，大多数对抗样本试图通过限制扰动的 $L_p$ 范数来保证“微小扰动”。在本文中，我们旨在通过操纵图像的语义属性来探究语义操纵对深度神经网络预测的影响，并生成“无限制对抗样本”。具体而言，我们提出了一种名为 SemanticAdv 的算法，该算法利用解耦的语义因子，通过改变受控的语义属性来生成对抗扰动，从而欺骗学习器使其朝向各种“对抗”目标。我们进行了大量实验，结果表明基于语义的对抗样本不仅能够……
tldr: 本文提出SemanticAdv算法，通过属性条件图像编辑操纵图像的语义属性，生成不受Lp范数限制的“无限制对抗样本”，从而欺骗深度神经网络做出错误预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SemanticAdv, an algorithm that leverages disentangled semantic factors to generate unrestricted adversarial examples by manipulating semantic attributes of images, thereby fooling deep neural networks without perturbation constraints.
